title: Hanging Potato Recipes
description: A data pack made for Hanging Potato resource pack.
body:
A data pack made for **[Hanging Potato](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hanging-potato)** resource pack.  
Now, you can craft four Hanging Potato with **wooden slabs, chains and potatoes**.
